title: Tenma Saki — Abyss Of Memories〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Saki, dinner's ready.
I'm sure you're hungry since you didn't have lunch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You've done your part for us.
Now, it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good luck!
I'll leave the rest to all of you, so I'm gonna..
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. I've been asleep this entire time. I was so sleepy that I couldn't get up and missed lunch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that was so good!
And I feel so refreshed after getting in so much sleep♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, wait. I shouldn't let my guard down...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone told me to take today off. I should be resting as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's a bit early for bed, but laying down might help me fall asleep.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't feel sleepy at all!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I usually get a little sleepy after having a meal, but I slept so much today that I'm wide awake now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe I slept a little too much during the day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I could practice for a bit.
I do need to work on some of the finer details for that song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You've done your part for us.
Now, it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and the others said so themselves. My job right now is to rest!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'll try going to sleep again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Hey, what do you guys do when you have trouble falling asleep?>
I wonder if anyone's gonna reply...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, they replied!
Alright, lay it on me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Good morning, Saki. Are you having trouble falling asleep because you slept during the day?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Some healing music might help you relax. I'll post a few songs I like, so I hope you get a chance to listen to them.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <If you need a way to relax, then I recommend stretching. I'll post some good videos for you to watch.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, Hona, thank you so much!
Your ideas sound great!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I can play some healing music while I stretch!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
<What about reading a textbook?
I'm guessing you'll be out like a light after five lines of your history textbook.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Thank you all so much! I'll try all of your suggestions♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start by putting on some healing music and one of those stretching videos...

rows.Speaker: Stretching Video
rows.Line: <We'll start from a relaxed position by sitting on the bed or the floor. Next, slowly take a deep breath...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Good, I feel much more relaxed now. I can try Shiho's suggestion next and try reading one of my textbooks...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll just end up reading Modern Japanese or Classics like normal so... How about math...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (While I'm at it, I should probably review some of the stuff we went over in class... Let's see... Yeah, this page...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? There's something written on this page... A note?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh noooo!
I totally forgot about that math assignment!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do?!
When do we have class...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Argh! First thing in the morning!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still have time! It's not that late yet!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll go to bed after doing this.
